field.label: Dish address
field.help: IP address of the dish. Starlink dishes always use 192.168.100.1. OPNsense needs a route to it (for example an IP alias 192.168.100.2/24 on the WAN).

field.label: gRPC-Web port
field.help: Dish gRPC-Web port used as a fallback, normally 9201.

field.label: Transport
field.help: How to talk to the dish. Automatic tries gRPC first, then gRPC-Web.

field.label: Dish model
field.help: Controls which features are shown. Automatic reads the model from the dish. Pick a model to hide controls it does not have, or "Show everything" if a feature is missing.

field.label: Status refresh (seconds)
field.help: How often the status page refreshes. 0 disables auto refresh.
